Bid Summary.value: Lakeview County Department of Public Works is soliciting bids for Fleet Charging Infrastructure. The contract term is two years from notice to proceed, with two optional one-year renewals. The project requires the installation of 12 DC Fast Chargers (150 kW minimum) and 36 Level 2 Chargers (19.2 kW minimum). Installation must be completed within 150 calendar days after notice to proceed, as modified by Addendum No. 1. Bidders must provide a minimum six-year manufacturer's warranty for charging equipment, as modified by Addendum No. 1. The electronic bid submission deadline is December 17, 2026 at 3:00 PM EST, as modified by Addendum No. 1.
